notes: Condensed from the 0.4.1 tokenizer work. A production outage class traced to a dependency's lazy network fetch.

messages.content: 21 percent of the test suite fails here. Why?
All of them trace to one cause: tiktoken downloads its BPE vocabulary from a CDN on first use, and this sandbox has no egress. The failure is a ProxyError.
is that only a test problem

No. _get_encoding in core/tokenizer.py catches only ImportError, so the network error propagates out of count_messages_tokens, which is on the hot path of every request. Every request returns 500 on an air-gapped host.
There is a char/4 fallback but it is unreachable — it only runs when tiktoken is absent entirely. Decided: catch broadly and cache the failure so it is not retried per request.
Decided: pre-download the vocabulary at image build time with TIKTOKEN_CACHE_DIR. Updated the Dockerfile. Working on a CI step that runs the image with the network removed to prove the bake worked.
